items.title: ComfyUI-H3-RDNA4（Radiance 后端）R9700 实测：H3 R2V 采样 2.01×
items.summary: 应 @ Bunsei 大佬的指示，测试一下 R9700采样后端从原生换成 Radiance 加速的生成速度。 结论：同一条 H3 参考图生视频工作流（1344×768 / 294帧 / 20步 / seed 12345 / 6参考图），采样后端从原生换成 Radiance，全流程 4650s → 2314s，加速 2.01×。 前置条件：ComfyUI ≥ v0.45.0、原生组件按 gfx1201 编译、实例启动加 --reserve-vram 22 。双卡 TP 在 X99 + IOMMU 平台不可用（还没测通，后面再研究）。

content.html:
应@Bunsei大佬的指示，测试一下 R9700采样后端从原生换成 Radiance 加速的生成速度。

结论：同一条 H3 参考图生视频工作流（1344×768 / 294帧 / 20步 / seed 12345 / 6参考图），采样后端从原生换成 Radiance，全流程 4650s → 2314s，加速 2.01×。前置条件：ComfyUI ≥ v0.45.0、原生组件按 gfx1201 编译、实例启动加--reserve-vram 22。双卡 TP 在 X99 + IOMMU 平台不可用（还没测通，后面再研究）。

上对比图片：

环境

项值
硬件X99-TF / E5-2696 v3 / 128G ECC / 双 R9700 32G (gfx1201)
系统Ubuntu 26.04.1 / ROCm 7.2.4 / torch 2.14.1+rocm7.2
ComfyUIv0.44.0 →v0.45.0（Radiance 硬依赖）
插件codeberg.org/Bunsei/ComfyUI-H3-RDNA4v0.2.0，装到custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Video-Radiance
编译python tools/build_native.py --arch gfx1201 --jobs 16，约 5 分钟；check_environment.py返回 ok:true

工作流接入

不改动原生骨架：UNET → 采样器之间插H3 视频加速（H3RadianceAccelerator，INT8 QK＋FP8 PV，devices 0），条件编码换H3 参考素材与提示词（H3RadianceReferences），解码换H3 视频解码（H3RadianceDecode）。Qwen 32B NVFP4-AWQ 编码器直接沿用「高精度加速」线性档。

测试配置（32GB 单卡档）

节点参数值
采样精度INT8 QK＋FP8 PV
激活缓冲位置显存
每卡预留显存4096 MiB
每卡主机权重池24576 MiB
暂存线性权重开
复用主干输入缓冲开
前馈/线性分块4096 / 4096
ComfyUI 启动--reserve-vram 22

实测数据

指标原生Radiance加速比
全流程（同工作流同 seed）4650 s2314 s2.01×
采样每步≈210 s（按总时长扣除预处理/解码推算）101.5 s（20 步全程 101.3~104.7 s，零衰减）≈2.07×
预处理（6 图 1344×768 match + 音频基准）—172 s—
出片1344×768 / 294 帧 / 24fps / 12.25s完全一致—
文件体积12.4 MB12.5 MB—
视频对比https://youtu.be/7dSj4cW1PaEhttps://youtu.be/t-0brZVj774—

画质体检（边缘密度法，抽 1/3/5/7/9/11 秒共 6 帧，单位 %）：

Radiance: 7.48 15.74 7.39 10.67 15.95 15.74
原生: 8.02 15.59 8.30 9.72 13.44 17.09

两版逐秒几乎重合，全部在健康带内，无 latent 崩坏。同 seed 下 INT8 QK＋FP8 PV 与原生精度数值不逐像素一致，构图/动作一致。

坑（现象 / 根因 / 解法）

现象根因解法
_forward_unimplemented() got an unexpected keyword argument 'transformer_options'Radiance 替换diffusion_model._run_blocks，v0.44 的 minimax 前向是手动逐块迭代、无此方法ComfyUI 升级 ≥ v0.45.0（git fetch --tags后git checkout v0.45.0）
worker 启动报VRAM does not cover the fixed costs before a single pool is sized（short by 3.29 GiB，报告显示主进程已占 20.77 GiB）Comfy-Kitchen 量化加载（fast_disk 策略）绕过 torch 分配器，Radiance 的 free_memory / partially_unload 驱逐不动实例启动加--reserve-vram 22，DiT 部分加载，卡净空升至 ~24 GB
预处理只跑 40 秒后报Qwen attention requires CUDA/ROCm tensors on the same device--lowvram把 Qwen 文本编码器整体压到 CPU不要用--lowvram，用--reserve-vram
双卡报GPU 1 is not visible to ComfyUI实例带CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0双卡模式去掉该环境变量
双卡 TP 单步 1037 s 起步、首步 25 分钟未完成（单卡对照 419 s/步）X99 + IOMMU 转译（DMA-FQ）下 P2P 同步代价爆炸，激活缓冲/张量交换走主机的模式每步流量翻倍本平台判死；需 Resizable BAR / 现代 PCIe 平台再测
单卡速度掉到 256~419 s/步激活缓冲挪内存 + 未开暂存/复用缓冲显存激活缓冲 +weight_staging+reuse_hidden_buffer，三项缺一不可

注意点

  • INT8 有效权重容器 ≈ 18 GiB，设计为部分驻留显存 + 锁页权重池 DMA 直读（与计算重叠），权重不常驻显存不是降速路径。
  • worker 启动顺序是先装权重容器和 IPC，再核算激活缓冲 + headroom + 队列空间；不够时报错附精确账本（card total / already held / arena / short by），按账本挤空间：--reserve-vram→ headroom 4096→2048 → IPC 4→2 GiB → 分块 4096→2048。
  • 采样记录在~/.cache/ComfyUI-H3-Video-Radiance/runs/*.json（含 worker_log 与 memory_handoffs），预处理/解码记录分别在preprocessing/、decoding/。
  • --reserve-vram 22会让主进程 DiT 部分加载，跑原生（非 Radiance）工作流前建议去掉该参数重启实例。

以上为单卡 32G 数据。双卡 TP 的平台前提（P2P 直通、Resizable BAR）不具备之前不再浪费时间（双卡 TP 还需要继续研究配置）；有现代平台数据的欢迎贴一下对比。

content.html:
inference-optimisation

An agent skill forhill-climbing the speed of a local LLM serveron any hardware and any quantization. It covers:

  • single-user and concurrent decode
  • speculative decoding
  • prefill
  • KV cache size
  • startup time and time to first token

It works under a memory cap, and every result has to survive a full-context stability check.

It encodes how we actually got these speedups. It is not a list of flags. The workflow:

  1. Compute the theoretical ceiling.
  2. Change one thing at a time.
  3. Measure against interleaved controls.
  4. Log every result, including the failures.
  5. Gate on long-context retrieval.
  6. Qualify a clean, pinned build before publishing.

It works with Claude Code and any agent that loadsSKILL.md-style skills. Any model can also follow it from [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md).

What we've been able to accomplish

Results from the hill-climbs this skill was distilled from. Every number was measured on the hardware named; see the linked sources for methods and raw data.

| Hardware | Model / quant / engine | Before → after | |---|---|---| |Intel Arc B390 iGPU(laptop, 64 GB unified LPDDR5X, ~115 GB/s) | Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, EXL3 4 bpw, SGLang XPU + MTP | Decode, 1 user: 43.6 →53 tok/s(median)<br>Decode, 4 users: 84.7 →103 tok/s<br>Prefill 32K: 1,037 →1,660 tok/s<br>Prefill 256K: 297 →628 tok/s(2.1×)<br>KV cache: 264K tokens →4 × 256K<br>Startup: 113 →43 s<br>Registry Lab gates: decode 28.6 →41.0, prefill 255 →667| |Intel Arc Pro B70| Qwen3.8-27B, EXL3 4 bpw, vLLM + custom XPU kernels | Decode:91.2 tok/sat 1 user,365at 16 (prose, thinking on)<br>Same card with llama.cpp Q4_K_M: 25.0<br>Prefill 4K/32K/128K/254K: 1,654/1,434/928/650 →2,421/2,259/1,415/911<br>Agent-session replay: 193 →147 s| |Intel Arc Pro B70| Same model, SGLang + the same kernels | Decode, 1 user:82.6 tok/s, vs vLLM 75.7 on the same card and day | |RTX 3090| Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 3 bpw + MTP |96.2 tok/sprose /141.1code, 1 user | |RTX 3090| Qwen3.6-35B-A3B EXL3 3 bpw + MTP |251.7 / 357.9 tok/s, 1 user | |RTX 3090| Flash-Next EXL3, 256K context | MTP: 45.5 →65.6 tok/s| |4× H200 NVL| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, vLLM + speculative decoding | Crashed under load →229.1 tok/sdecode,17,546 tok/sprefill; all six gates pass |

Sources:

  • local-ai-registry:
  • Ornith B390 recipe, with the full hill-climb log inPR #453
  • the RTX 3090 and H200 recipes
  • trellis-serve:
  • xpu/README.md,xpu/docs/PROGRESS.mdandxpu/docs/SGLANG.mdfor B70
  • cuda/README.mdfor the RTX 3090
  • qwen-serve

Reading the B390 result

That run is the one this skill grew out of. Its ceiling calculation said:

  • Decode:100 tok/s for one user was only reachable with two useful speculative drafts. This model's draft head accepts ~14% at depth 2, so the practical target was ~88–97 tok/s. We reached ~55% of it; the rest is GEMV kernel efficiency.
  • Prefill at 256K:we reached 628 tok/s against a ~670–684 tok/s ceiling.

The skill makes the agent compute this up front, so it can tell you early when a target is above the physics.

How it works

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
measure HW ─▶ │ THEORY.md: bytes/token ÷ bandwidth, FLOPs/token ÷ 50% peak, KV │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
│
baseline ─▶ profile ─▶ pick lever (ceiling gap × likelihood) ─▶ configs/NEW.json
▲ │
│ queue.sh ctl NEW ctl (serialized, AC-only,
│ memory watchdog, ≥6 samples, medians)
│ │
PLAN.md + ledger.jsonl ◀── accept only if it beats BOTH neighbouring controls ──┘
│ and regresses nothing by >3%
▼
long-context needle gate ─▶ concurrent full-KV soak ─▶ plateau? ─▶ pinned clean build
─▶ acceptance gates ─▶ publish

The skill has three parts:

[SKILL.md](skills/inference-optimisation/SKILL.md): the procedure.

  • Inventory, ceilings, ground rules, the loop and lever order.
  • When to stop, how to qualify and publish, and how to report.

[references/](skills/inference-optimisation/references): loaded only when needed.

你的年度游戏是什么？

国区 App Store 将 AIGC 合规材料设为上架必填

11 月 16 日，有开发者反馈苹果在 App Store Connect 后台新增「人工智能生成或合成内容（AIGC）服务声明与备案信息」与「已完成安全评估的证明」2 项中国大陆分发必填项。此举将 2026 年审核指南的生成式 AI 条款变为提交入口的强制执行，合规材料从建议变成上架的前置条件。含 AIGC 服务的 App 需提交备案及安全评估报告副本。若使用第三方技术或模型，还须提供授权或盖章合作协议与算法备案号。新 App 需立即提交，现有 App 须在 2027 年 1 月 31 日前完成。来源

国区特殊要求备案的麻烦程度比整个App Store 上架的难度都要高了，再这样下去，可能比开发软件的难度还要高
声名AI真的有那么重要吗？变种人法案？
美丽新世界
有机App专栏：纯天然，保证不含任何AI添加剂 🐒
当个开发者是真难

OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 模型

OpenAI 于当地时间 11 月 17 日发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol，两款模型同日上线 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 API。官方称两款模型都能用更少的输出 token 完成高难度任务，用户在同一付费额度内可以完成更多工作。

Astra 定位为处理最难项目的模型，官方推荐用于文档、演示文稿、编码等专业场景。它可以用一张幻灯片截图当模板，匹配其版式、配色甚至字号，生成风格一致的整套演示文稿。在 Codex 一侧，Astra 更擅长在既有项目中做修改与测试，官方称早期测试者反馈代码风格更干净、测试更聚焦、返工轮次更少。Sol 则定位为日常编码与写作中更便宜的模型。Cognition 的 FrontierCode 2.0 测试衡量「对真实代码库的改动是否达到维护者可合并的标准」，两款模型都开到最高推理力度时，Sol 的成绩只比 Astra 低半分，成本约为 Astra 的五分之一。

两款模型即日起向 Plus、Pro、Enterprise、Edu 用户开放，覆盖 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex。Ultrafast 高速模式首次向每月 200 美元的 Pro 档开放，先支持 Sol；每月 500 美元的 Pro 档与 Enterprise、Edu 工作区可对两款模型使用，后者需由管理员开启。官方称该模式生成速度最高为标准速率的 4.5 倍，但更消耗使用额度，可在模型选择器中切换。API 定价按每百万 token 计，Astra 输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.4 美元、输出 40 美元，比上一代 GPT-6 Astra 的标准输入输出价格低 20%；Sol 维持 GPT-6.1 定价，输入 2 美元、缓存输入 0.1 美元、输出 10 美元。来源

那也就是说dot没有呗

iPhone Duo 测试 2D 人脸解锁功能

iOS 27.3 开发者测试版新增「用前置摄像头解锁」选项，iPhone Duo 可用 2D 人脸识别解锁屏幕。设置过程与 Face ID 类似，但无需缓慢转头，只需把头向左、右、上、下各转 1 次，约 5 秒完成；解锁速度约 0.5 秒，环境非常暗的情况下会解锁失败。同时，因为 iPhone Duo 不具备 TrueDepth 相机的红外深度图，苹果在设置时也会提示该功能「不如 Touch ID 或 Face ID 安全」，理论上可被照片或视频欺骗，实测每次欺骗解锁失败后下次解锁会强制要求 Touch ID，画面无人脸则不强制。该功能只能用于锁屏解锁，使用 Apple Pay、安装或登录应用仍需 Touch ID 或密码。来源

此外，iOS 27.3 开发者测试版也为国行 iPad 和 Mac 新增「Apple 智能」，支持搭载 M 系列芯片的 Mac 和 iPad 以及采用 A17 Pro 与 A20 Pro 芯片的 iPad mini，但国行版本不包含 Siri AI。来源

一直在用三星的折叠屏，侧面指纹解锁其实挺好用的，不知道为啥苹果认为不合适。
那么贵的手机，又是2D人脸，又是侧面指纹识别。当初喷某品牌手机的人，怎么都禁声了？（包括但不限于索尼、华为、荣耀、小米等等）

松下发布紧凑型电影摄影机 SHX1

11 月 17 日，松下发布紧凑型电影摄影机 LUMIX SHX1，型号为 AU-SHX1。该机采用带光学低通滤镜的 6K 全画幅部分堆栈式 CMOS 传感器，可减轻果冻效应并支持高帧率录制配合双原生 ISO 与动态范围增强，该机在 V-Log 下动态范围达 15 档；预装 ARRI LogC3，用户可在 V-Log 与 ARRI LogC3 之间按调色流程选择；该机无需外接录机即可录制 2 种 RAW 格式，可将 Apple ProRes RAW 内录至 CFexpress Type B 卡，也是首个支持直接向外部 SSD 录制 Blackmagic RAW 的 LUMIX 机型，素材无需转码即可在 DaVinci Resolve 中直接剪辑，并可选用 Blackmagic 色彩科学。此外，该机还在 LUMIX 中首次支持 Open Gate 录制 Blackmagic RAW 6K 24p。

机身方面，LUMIX SHX1 采用铝镁合金框架，兼顾散热、耐用与轻量，重量约 984 g。该机配备大尺寸散热风扇与独立散热系统，提供 CFexpress Type B 与 SD 双卡槽，并在 LUMIX 中首次支持 Micro V 口电池。LUMIX SHX1 售价 4699.99 美元，将于 12 月起分批上市。来源

影目发布 INMO Future 智能眼镜

影目于 11 月 17 日推出 INMO Future 智能眼镜，采用双目全彩阵列光波导方案，首发价 5999 元。整机约 125g，采用 ABS 与 PC 材质，前后重心配比为 4:6；镜身内置多层导热材料与微型离心风扇组成的主动散热系统，日常运行噪音约 40dB，并支持磁吸与卡扣式近视镜片，适配 -8D 至 +2D 的视力范围。

显示部分匹配 1080P 单眼分辨率、120Hz 的 Micro OLED 面板，视场角 36°，官方称可在 6 米处呈现 150 英寸画面，入眼亮度最高 800 尼特，非光栅区透光率 90%，屏幕亮度均匀性不低于 80%，畸变率低于 1.5%。机身配备一枚 1600 万像素摄像头，提供 3DoF 与 6DoF 空间计算能力，可结合大模型实现自然语言语音交互与物体识别，搭配便携外设 INMO Controller 还能使用「3DoF 射线交互」。

硬件方面，该机配备 8GB 内存与 128GB 存储、双声道立体声扬声器与四麦克风阵列，内置 880mAh 电池，支持 PD3.0 与 QC4.0+ 快充。来源

这外观像上个时代的产物呀

Google Play 公布 2026 年度最佳应用、游戏与图书榜单

11 月 17 日，Google 公布 Google Play 年度 Best of Play 奖项结果，分为应用、游戏、图书 3 类。年度最佳应用由 Notability 获得，官方称其获奖原因包括 AI 功能；年度最佳游戏为《明日方舟：终末地》。此外，Strava 与 Moonlight Peaks 因在手机、平板和个人电脑上的跨设备表现获得表彰。此外亚太各地区另有本地榜单，例如日本的最佳应用为 Asken、最佳游戏为 hololive Dreams。来源

商汤开源 SenseNova Loop-9B 正式版

11 月 17 日，商汤发布 SenseNova Loop-9B 正式版，并开放模型权重与代码。该版本与 10 月 31 日的 Preview 不同。模型约有 9B 参数，通过循环复用中间层，把 32 个物理解码层扩展为 56 次层计算，支持文本和图像输入、文本输出，上下文最长 512K tokens。官方同时提供 AWQ 4-bit 量化版。

在官方模型卡列出的对比中，Loop-9B 正式版在 NL2Repo 上的成绩为 41.…

李沐加盟的Aimotion，是一家什么AI公司？

思邈2026-11-1719:40:37来源：量子位

瞄准「产业级世界模型」

允中 发自 凹非寺

量子位 | 公众号QbitAI

AI大神李沐，悄悄多了一个新身份。

最新消息，这位前AWS AI资深首席科学家、Apache MXNet创始人之一、卡内基梅隆计算机博士，已经正式出任硅谷AI公司Aimotion的联合创始人兼CTO，亲自带队搭建其下一代产业级AI技术体系。

这家公司来头不小，Aimotion主要面向汽车等高价值、长决策周期行业，提供AI销售与营销解决方案，业务覆盖美洲、欧洲、亚太等市场。近期，他们刚刚完成了数千万美元A轮融资，领投方是BAI Capital。

△图源：Aimotion官网

需要说明的是，李沐并未因此离开他所创立的Boson AI。据了解，他将继续担任Boson AI联合创始人兼CTO，促成两家公司联合攻关：

产业级世界模型与商业AI Agent技术。

具体而言，就是将Boson AI的底层模型能力与Aimotion的真实产业场景沉淀深度融合，打通基础技术与产业应用闭环，共同打造面向商业环境的产业级世界模型。

什么是产业级世界模型？

区别于通用仿真类世界模型，这一技术将对商业规则、客户决策逻辑、业务因果关系进行建模，实现场景推演、趋势预判与长周期任务规划。

借此，AI Agent将从被动问答升级为可自主执行复杂销售业务的智能主体，推动AI由营销辅助工具转变为创造实际收益的商业智能系统。

李沐表示，AI下一阶段的发展核心在于深度落地复杂商业场景，充分释放下一代商业智能体的价值。

关于更多技术与产品细节，Aimotion表示将于后续择机披露。

content.html:
<p align="center"><img src="https://github.com/MatinSenPai/Gemini-Config-Checker/raw/main/assets/banner.png" alt="Gemini/Check" width="100%"></p>

<p align="center"> <b>English</b> · <a href="README.fa.md">فارسی</a> </p>

<p align="center"> <a href="https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/l80rdcm1o9gnqcpdsw1gi/GeminiConfigChecker.rar?rlkey=dv7oxsttd2j8kvr5zu7uyx1tm&st=l2vaozdz&dl=1"> <img alt="Download the Gemini app" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-%20Gemeni%20app-0969DA?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white"> </a> </p>

Gemini Config Checker

Find proxy configs that actually get you intoGoogle AI Studio and Gemini, by testing each one the way a person would: in a *signed-in* browser, through the route you will really use.

>Version 0.1.0, early pre-release.It works end to end on Windows (the only platform it has been run on so far). The macOS, > Linux and Android builds come from the CI pipeline and have not been exercised on real devices yet. Please report what you find.

Two modes, one switch

The bigSimple / Advancedswitch in the header decides what is tested. The route diagram under the title morphs to show it.

| |Simple|Advanced| |---|---|---| | Question it answers | *Which of my configs work?* | *Which free configs work through my config?* | | Route | you →config→ AI Studio / Gemini | you →base config→free config→ AI Studio / Gemini | | You provide | your configs (links, a subscription URL or base64), or pick a ready-made free list | one working base config, plus a free list or pasted configs | | Anti-DPI profile is applied to | every config under test (each one connects from your machine) | the base config's first hop (free configs run inside its tunnel) | | Typical use | check a pile of configs you already have; test a config before you rely on it | your Cloudflare config works, but you need a *different exit* that Google accepts | | Export | links, base64, a full Xray config of one config | links, base64, a chain Xray config (base → free) |

Contents

[Credits](#credits-and-references) · [Why a signed-in browser](#why-a-signed-in-browser) · [Download and install](#download-and-install) · [User guide](#user-guide) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting-and-faq) · [Privacy and security](#privacy-and-security) · [Build from source](#build-from-source) · [Releases and CI](#releases-and-ci)

Credits and references

This project exists because of other people's work. Please go and use and star them.

| Project | What it gave us | |---|---| |0xRadikal/Free-v2ray-Configs| The auto-updated lists of free configs (verified,fast,secure, ...) that this tool scans | |patterniha|PattN(Windows / Linux / macOS client) andPattNG(Android): the anti-DPI recipe, plus the fragmentfinalmasksemantics from hisXray-core forkthat our fragmenting forwarder reproduces | |bia-pain-bache/BPB-Worker-Panel| The Cloudflare Worker panel that produces many of the base configs this tool chains behind (patterniha maintains afork) | |Anti-DPI recipe post| The exact Finalmask / fingerprint / ALPN / cipher values used as defaults | |MatinSenPai/SenPaiScanner| Companion tool for finding clean Cloudflare IPs to use as a config's address | |XTLS/Xray-core| The proxy engine embedded in the app | |2dust/v2rayN| The config layout the "Copy with chain" export follows (PattN is a fork of it) | |Wails| The native desktop shell | |VazirmatnandJetBrains Mono| The fonts used in the UI (SIL Open Font License) |

Why a signed-in browser?

Google decides region availabilityper signed-in account, after the page has loaded. A plain HTTP request (even to the Gemini API with a dummy key) answers "fine" from every country, so connectivity probes mark every live config as healthy. Measured while building this tool: exits geolocated to the US, HK and SG were blocked, and the same exit can flip over time. The only reliable signal is what Google shows a signed-in user, so that is what this tool reads:

items.summary: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. content.html: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

items.title: ScenarioForge: Resource-Grounded Generation and Execution Validation of Cyber Exercises
items.summary: Cyber-range and capture-the-flag scenario construction remains labor-intensive because authors must coordinate infrastructure, vulnerable services, attack paths, artifacts, and success conditions. LLMs can propose detailed exercises, but plausible descriptions do not guarantee deployable software or verifiable objecti…

content.html: Cyber-range and capture-the-flag scenario construction remains labor-intensive because authors must coordinate infrastructure, vulnerable services, attack paths, artifacts, and success conditions. LLMs can propose detailed exercises, but plausible descriptions do not guarantee deployable software or verifiable objectives. We present ScenarioForge, which turns high-level requirements into resource-grounded topologies, services, traffic, segmentation, and challenge chains, then instantiates and validates them in the Common Open Research Emulator (CORE). The ScenarioForge Execution Dataset contains 226 materialized scenarios covering 294 Vulhub images and all 85 custom-built challenge-resource generators developed with our AI-assisted scaffolding. All 226 passed construction, preview, sequencing, deployment, strict runtime validation, and live artifact checks; their 867 steps, each an individually verifiable challenge objective, comprise 457 vulnerability-backed and 410 generated-resource-backed instances. In a separate 50-prompt matched benchmark, ScenarioForge+Qwen3.8 and ScenarioForge+GPT5.6 each achieved 50/50 (100%) topology/build success and 160/160 intent fields; direct frontier generation reached 41/50 builds and 147/160 fields only with the full cumulative scaffold: structure, vocabulary, policy, and container-image guidance. The test still omitted ScenarioForge's downstream challenge-resource generation, dependency/flag sequencing, deployment, and live validation. The artifacts support operationally rich, reproducible exercises for training and evaluation.

items.title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting with Physics-Indexed Specialist Memory: the Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent
items.summary: Continual reinforcement learning requires adaptation to changing conditions while preserving performance under previously encountered dynamics. It was investigated whether specialists generated by evolutionary search can provide a reusable memory when combined with environment detection and failure-driven search. The…

content.html: Continual reinforcement learning requires adaptation to changing conditions while preserving performance under previously encountered dynamics. It was investigated whether specialists generated by evolutionary search can provide a reusable memory when combined with environment detection and failure-driven search. The Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent (ENA) evolves small neural networks without gradients, archives selected policies by detected dynamic regime, and retrieves them through Bayesian policy reuse. The architecture was evaluated in non-stationary CartPole and HalfCheetah environments. In the 30-replicate CartPole ablation, the complete architecture achieved a mean success rate of 83.2% across the five test environments. Among variants that learned the harder CartPole environments, the complete architecture showed the most consistent retention. A selection ablation also showed that the retrieval rule affected performance. In the evaluated sequences, ENA adapted more slowly than PPO on CartPole and achieved lower returns than SAC on HalfCheetah. The evidence concerns the complete architecture and does not isolate gradient-free optimization as the cause of retention or establish superiority over other continual-learning methods.

items.title: Surrogate-Assisted Compact-Model Extraction for SKY130 CMOS at 77 K
items.summary: Cryogenic circuit design requires compact transistor models that reproduce measured low-temperature behavior and run in standard circuit simulators. We fit BSIM4 parameters to measured I-V curves of SkyWater 130 nm (SKY130) transistors at 77 K using a neural surrogate of NGSpice. The surrogate maps compact-model param…

content.html: Cryogenic circuit design requires compact transistor models that reproduce measured low-temperature behavior and run in standard circuit simulators. We fit BSIM4 parameters to measured I-V curves of SkyWater 130 nm (SKY130) transistors at 77 K using a neural surrogate of NGSpice. The surrogate maps compact-model parameters and device geometry to the complete set of output and transfer characteristics. Extraction is a bounded least-squares search: a bank of NGSpice simulations supplies initial candidates, finite differences of the surrogate supply the local Jacobian, and NGSpice re-simulates the resulting cards before selection. On 18 measured geometries, we compare a search over seven card parameters with a search over 43 parameters selected by NGSpice sensitivity. Relative to NGSpice re-simulations of the previously released cards, the two searches reduce the in-sample mean relative root-mean-square error (RRMS) by 17% and 26%, respectively. The 43-parameter search has the lower overall error, but the seven-parameter search has the lower mean on high-bias curves, and some individual curves have higher error than with the released cards under both searches.

items.title: KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders
items.summary: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stor…

content.html: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase. Given these ranking LLM calls are prefill heavy (long prompt but short decoded output) and repeatedly called, these repeated prefill of user profile text dominates the serving. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. We present KVUse, which stores the user profiles as reusable key-value (KV) caches instead of text. KVUse trains lightweight LoRA writers by self-distillation, so that the user profile update call produces the reusable KV of the user profile while decoding it, and the LLM can read these reusable KV at new positions and behind new context without recomputation. KVUse also has a customized KV scheduler that uploads the stored reusable KV of the next batch while the current batch is computed, hiding the KV transfer from host memory behind GPU computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, KVUse shows no statistically significant difference in ranking quality from full prefill over continuous memory update rounds. Under saturated load, KVUse raises the throughput of the downstream scoring path by 4.0x-4.5x and of the profile update path by 1.4x-1.9x.

items.title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range o…

content.html: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

items.title: SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
items.summary: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regu…

content.html: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regularization after the projector cannot correct it, and the differences between representations shrink until they collapse. We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed. SADL compares the representation differences that the projector output demands with the differences the encoder can retain and pass on to the projector, and adds a constraint on the encoder only when supply falls short of demand. It works with different Demand Regularizers and introduces no auxiliary networks, additional trainable parameters, or architectural changes. In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%. After one epoch of training, encoder effective rank is 3.4-6.4 times that of the corresponding baseline without SADL, and latent prediction error falls to 1/20-1/303 of it. Without additional tuning, SADL stays robust as its loss weight spans orders of magnitude, and with several Demand Regularizers INTACT exceeds 95% mean search-free control success. On four image datasets, SADL also consistently improves accuracy and stability across random seeds. These results show that matching the representation differences a regularizer demands with the differences the encoder can supply leads to faster and more stable representation learning in control and image classification.

In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%. After one epoch of training, encoder effective rank is 3.4-6.4 times that of the corresponding baseline without SADL, and latent prediction error falls to 1/20-1/303 of it. Without additional tuning, SADL stays robust as its loss weight spans orders of magnitude, and with several Demand Regularizers INTACT exceeds 95% mean search-free control success. On four image datasets, SADL also consistently improves accuracy and stability across random seeds. These results show that matching the representation differences a regularizer demands with the differences the encoder can supply leads to faster and more stable representation learning in control and image classification.

<!DOCTYPE html>
< img id="wx_img" src="https://www.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/imgs/qbitai-logo-1.png" width="400" height="400">

材料科学智能体MatOS正式开源！大幅提高材料研发任务成功率

思邈2026-11-1714:09:40来源：量子位

筛材料、找配方、开发新模型…拿下多项科研任务

允中 发自 凹非寺

量子位 | 公众号QbitAI

大模型智能体已经能够检索文献、调用模拟软件，甚至与自动化实验室协同工作。但要让它们独立完成一项完整的材料研究，仍然面临挑战：

一项研究可能要从数千万个候选结构中逐级筛选，或在数百个合金配方中反复搜索，持续数天，并根据中间结果不断调整计划；每接入一个新的数据库或软件，往往要重新搭建流程；一项研究中积累的经验，也很难被其他研究复用。

为此，北京中关村学院、中关村人工智能研究院（中关村两院）于今年九月发布年度科研进展——MatOS，一个面向材料研发的科研智能体系统。

该项目由中关村两院AI材料研究所团队构建，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流统一组织为科学资产，支持研究者和MatOS自身在已有资产之上构建新能力，通过有状态工作流执行研究任务，并将经过检查与审查的资产修订用于后续研究，使科研能力在使用中持续进化。

目前，MatOS的资产库已包含3,135个数据集、386项技能、104个工作流和51个专家角色，并集成48款材料计算软件；技术报告已在arXiv发布，代码已在GitHub开源。

在3项智能体基准和8个研究案例中，MatOS完成了从端到端自主研究、工具调用到大规模筛选、配方设计和新方法开发的多类任务，例如：

在端到端自主科研基准ResearchClawBench上，与采用相同底座模型的Codex CLI相比，平均得分高33.6%，材料任务高80.8%；

在材料软件使用基准MatTools上，与Codex CLI、Claude Code采用相同的底座模型时，完整问题成功率达到97.96%，为三者最高；

构建层次化筛选流程，从3000多万个候选结构中筛选出97个固态电解质候选；

支持开发合金熔点预测模型DuoCompNet，在固定测试集上的平均绝对误差降至3.18°C，比次优模型低13.6%。

从回答问题到开展研究，再到持续产出高质量科学资产

近年来，ChemCrow、LLaMP等工作让大模型能够调用专业工具，MARS等系统将智能体与自动化实验连接起来，科研智能体正在从回答问题走向开展研究。

材料研究对智能体系统提出了三方面要求：

数据库、模拟软件和机器学习势（用机器学习模型近似原子间作用力、加速模拟的方法）不断出现，要求系统无需重建即可接入新能力；

研究跨越文献分析、计算和实验，要求系统能够在长周期任务中保存状态、检查结果；

模拟时长、采样策略等经验大多来自实践，系统要能存储这些经验，并在后续任务中有效复用。

MatOS以三大设计回应这些要求：分层科学资产图组织并扩展研发能力，有状态自适应工作流调用资产执行任务并保存证据，证据驱动的资产进化将可复用的经验转化为经过检查与审查的资产修订。

MatOS整体架构：分层科学资产图、有状态的自适应工作流和证据驱动的资产进化。

三大设计：构建、执行与进化

分层科学资产图：组合已有能力，构建新能力

MatOS将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流，组织为六类科学资产。

每项资产都有唯一标识、声明的依赖关系和来源记录，既可以直接保存内容，也可以引用外部数据库或计算软件。

资产之间通过依赖、调用、证据、验证等类型化关系相连，智能体接到任务时，按照这些关系组合所需的能力。

其中，技能相当于一类研究问题的操作规程，规定何时使用、如何选择方法、需要哪些前提、如何执行以及如何检查结果；角色是由职责说明和可调用资产定义的专家智能体；工作流描述多个研究阶段如何衔接。同一技能可以供多个角色使用，同一角色也可以参与不同的工作流。

研究者和MatOS自身都可以在已有资产之上构建新的能力。

研究者可将数据库、软件或方法登记为资产，按接口与依赖关系组合为技能、角色或工作流；MatOS也可依据任务证据新建或修订资产，经检查与审查后供后续任务复用。资产的使用和修订均有记录，每一次改进都可以追溯。

MatOS科学资产的组织方式：（a）六类资产分属四个语义层，从数据、知识、工具、技能逐层抽象到角色和工作流；（b）以电池角色为例，角色从资产图中选取并组合数据、知识、工具、技能和工作流。

有状态自适应工作流：稳定执行与按需调整

工作流资产是可复用的流程描述，一次具体研究则通过执行图运行。执行图中的每个节点都写明目标、输入输出、完成条件和所引用的资产。系统按图调度和检查，只把方法选择、计划调整和异常解释等需要判断的环节交给智能体，需要研究者确认的步骤可以设为人工节点。

由于大模型面对相同输入也可能给出不同输出，长任务中的决策容易随上下文变化而偏离目标，因此MatOS通过显式的步骤和检查条件减少了执行对模型会话的依赖，降低了多步执行中偏离研究目标的风险。

执行图快照、节点状态、结果和事件记录都保存在系统中，独立于模型的会话。

耗时数天的计算交由后台执行，完成、需要输入或失去响应时，系统主动通知智能体；等待外部结果或人工输入的任务会保留进度，之后继续执行。每项输出都关联到产生它的节点和执行尝试。

中间结果可能要求调整后续步骤，例如先补充一步验证，再让后续分析以验证结果为准。这时，智能体或研究者可以提出对执行图的调整，增加或修改节点、改变依赖关系。调整须通过结构、策略和编译三道检查，通过后形成新版本的执行图；未通过时，原执行图继续运行。每次调整的提案、检查结果和采纳决定都有记录，执行图的演化过程可以完整追溯。

执行图的调整首先服务于当前任务。其中具有复用价值的流程改进，会作为证据进入资产进化，经检查与审查后用于修订相应的工作流资产，供后续同类任务调用。

有状态自适应工作流：节点类型、执行图及其动态调整、持久化状态。

证据驱动的资产进化：在使用中持续改进

用户纠正、失败的工具调用、反复出现的操作和工作流结果，都可能提示某项资产需要改进。

MatOS先评估证据是否充分、问题是否成立、经验能否复用，再定位到负责相应功能的资产：方法选择错误可能需要修订知识或技能，工具行为错误需要修复工具，缺少研究步骤则需要修订工作流；必要时也会新建资产，或同步修订多个关联资产。

例如，若反馈表明分子动力学模拟的平衡时间过短，系统可将对应技能中的平衡时长由50ps改为至少200ps，并增加一项检查，确认原子扩散已进入稳定状态。

候选修订须经过结构检查和基于模型的语义审查：结构检查主要判断是否引入新的结构、接口或组合错误；语义审查则判断修订是否回应了原始证据、保留了方法的适用条件，并与关联资产保持一致。

只有通过检查与审查的修订才会被采纳，后续任务的结果又成为下一轮评估的证据。这些经验保存在模型之外的资产中，基础语言模型的参数保持不变；资产也不绑定特定模型，评测中同一套MatOS分别搭配了GPT-5.4和DeepSeek系列模型。

证据驱动的资产进化：证据评估、目标定位、局部修订、结构检查与语义审查、版本采纳。

基准评测结果

ResearchClawBench要求系统依据文献和原始数据开展研究并提交报告。团队选取化学、能源和材料领域的12项任务，与MIRA、ResearchClaw、EvoScientist、Codex CLI等7个采用GPT-5.4的科研智能体进行比较。

采用GPT-5.4时，MatOS平均得分为19.46，较最佳基线MIRA高11.15%，较Codex CLI高33.6%。材料任务表现更突出：较MIRA高18.7%，较Codex CLI高80.8%。换用成本更低的DeepSeek-V4-Flash时，MatOS平均得分为19.20，同样高于全部基线。

ResearchClawBench化学、能源、材料任务的分领域平均得分与总体平均得分。

成本方面，DeepSeek-V4-Flash配置的单任务平均成本约为0.85美元，不到Codex CLI（2.70美元）的三分之一，得分更高；GPT-5.4配置则以约3.78美元的成本取得最高得分。两个MatOS配置共同扩展了本次评测中的成本—得分帕累托前沿（即在多个目标之间，找到一组各有取舍、但没有一个能被其他方案全面超越的最优选择）。

各系统的单任务平均成本与平均得分（成本为对数坐标）。

在材料软件使用基准MatTools和多步工具调用基准SciAgentGym上，MatOS、Codex CLI和Claude Code三个系统均以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为底座。

MatOS在MatTools上的完整问题成功率为97.96%，高于Codex CLI的95.92%和Claude Code的89.80%；子任务成功率为97.10%，另两者分别为95.65%和91.30%。在SciAgentGym上，MatOS的案例成功率为59.5%，高于另外两个系统的57.1%。

以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为共同底座，三个系统在MatTools和SciAgentGym上的成功率。

研究案例：从大规模筛选到新方法开发

8个研究案例覆盖机器学习势、固态与液态电解质、…

中间结果可能要求调整后续步骤，例如先补充一步验证，再让后续分析以验证结果为准。这时， 智能体或研究者可以提出对执行图的调整 ，增加或修改节点、改变依赖关系。调整须通过结构、策略和编译三道检查，通过后形成新版本的执行图；未通过时，原执行图继续运行。每次调整的提案、检查结果和采纳决定都有记录，执行图的演化过程可以完整追溯。
执行图的调整首先服务于当前任务。其中具有复用价值的流程改进，会作为证据进入资产进化，经检查与审查后用于修订相应的工作流资产，供后续同类任务调用。
有状态自适应工作流：节点类型、执行图及其动态调整、持久化状态。
证据驱动的资产进化：在使用中持续改进
用户纠正、失败的工具调用、反复出现的操作和工作流结果，都可能提示某项资产需要改进。
MatOS先评估证据是否充分、问题是否成立、经验能否复用，再定位到负责相应功能的资产：方法选择错误可能需要修订知识或技能，工具行为错误需要修复工具，缺少研究步骤则需要修订工作流；必要时也会新建资产，或同步修订多个关联资产。
例如，若反馈表明分子动力学模拟的平衡时间过短，系统可将对应技能中的平衡时长由50ps改为至少200ps，并增加一项检查，确认原子扩散已进入稳定状态。
候选修订须经过结构检查和基于模型的语义审查：结构检查主要判断是否引入新的结构、接口或组合错误；语义审查则判断修订是否回应了原始证据、保留了方法的适用条件，并与关联资产保持一致。
只有通过检查与审查的修订才会被采纳 ，后续任务的结果又成为下一轮评估的证据。 这些经验保存在模型之外的资产中，基础语言模型的参数保持不变 ；资产也不绑定特定模型，评测中同一套MatOS分别搭配了GPT-5.4和DeepSeek系列模型。
证据驱动的资产进化：证据评估、目标定位、局部修订、结构检查与语义审查、版本采纳。
基准评测结果
ResearchClawBench要求系统依据文献和原始数据开展研究并提交报告。团队选取化学、能源和材料领域的12项任务，与MIRA、ResearchClaw、EvoScientist、Codex CLI等7个采用GPT-5.4的科研智能体进行比较。
采用GPT-5.4时，MatOS平均得分为19.46，较最佳基线MIRA高11.15%，较Codex CLI高33.6%。材料任务表现更突出：较MIRA高18.7%，较Codex CLI高80.8%。换用成本更低的DeepSeek-V4-Flash时，MatOS平均得分为19.20，同样高于全部基线。
ResearchClawBench化学、能源、材料任务的分领域平均得分与总体平均得分。
成本方面，DeepSeek-V4-Flash配置的单任务平均成本约为0.85美元，不到Codex CLI（2.70美元）的三分之一，得分更高；GPT-5.4配置则以约3.78美元的成本取得最高得分。 两个MatOS配置共同扩展了本次评测中的成本—得分帕累托前沿（即在多个目标之间，找到一组各有取舍、但没有一个能被其他方案全面超越的最优选择） 。
各系统的单任务平均成本与平均得分（成本为对数坐标）。
在材料软件使用基准MatTools和多步工具调用基准SciAgentGym上，MatOS、Codex CLI和Claude Code三个系统均以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为底座。
MatOS在MatTools上的完整问题成功率为 97.96% ，高于Codex CLI的95.92%和Claude Code的89.80%；子任务成功率为 97.10% ，另两者分别为95.65%和91.30%。在SciAgentGym上，MatOS的案例成功率为 59.5% ，高于另外两个系统的57.1%。
以DeepSeek-V4-Pro为共同底座，三个系统在MatTools和SciAgentGym上的成功率。

content.html:
External sandboxes for coding agents

I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine.

I worked on this project withPrime Radiant, the AI research lab behind Superpowers andother projects.

My poston the Prime Radiant blog introduces theexternal sandboxpattern, where code executed by the agent runs inside a dedicated sandbox while the agent itself lives outside of that sandbox.

To demonstrate this pattern we've released three sandbox server implementations:

  • external-sandbox-v86runs a Node.js server which then usesv86to run Alpine Linux inside WebAssembly.
  • external-sandbox-containeris a Python web server which runs the sandbox in Alpine Linux inside an Apple Containers instance.
  • external-sandbox-quicksandis another Python web server, this time using Microsoft'sQuicksandsandboxing library, which bundles QEMUandAlpine Linux in a Python package!

Each of these implementations offers the same localhost API. You can then configure Pi, Claude Code, or Codex to send API calls to that sandbox any time they want to execute code.

The sandboxes also include an optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy, so you can control exactly which hosts your agent's code is allowed to communicate with - plus a credential replacement mechanism to make authenticated API calls without sharing a secret with the agent. Here's the UI you can use to reconfigure that proxy while the sandbox is still running:

I continue to be fascinated by the challenge of safely running untrusted code. This external sandbox pattern provides a neat way to experiment with different approaches.

Tags:sandboxing,security,ai,webassembly,generative-ai,llms,coding-agents,claude-code,codex,pi

content.html:
先简单介绍一下土豆姐，https://x.com/poteto
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_zcc6Xl12g&feature=youtu.be
前cursor的核心开发者，目前在grok。

土豆姐的爆火不言而喻，一定有grok、x、马斯克的商业策划营销在其中（包括土豆姐本人的形象在2023年后也有本质的蜕变，详见：https://x.com/kylewmi/status/2121945182082040132）。但土豆姐本身分享的知识还是很值得玩味的。核心一句话就是，AI时代，我们应该尽可能的通过可量化、自动化手段来审核AI产出。（从而烧更多的token，让马斯克赚更多钱）

1、不要用正常的人类验收思路。

土豆姐讲了一个实例，她通过定制一个编译器，来审核AI生成的react代码是否符合她的设计规范。不符合是不能编译（严格说是转译）通过的。这个思路就非常的值得借鉴。既，生产力无限的前提下，是不是有逻辑链条更短，更简单粗暴的路径来验证产出呢？

2、在AI生产的过程中，我们应该用管理学的视角来解决问题。

把AI看成是手下的员工，想象一下公司是如何管理职员的权限，以至于员工不会捅出无法弥补的篓子的。是不是应该根据当前项目的需求，因地制宜的禁用Agent的一些tool，以及bash、目录的访问权。是不是尽量的把能够用到的信息都集中到统一的目录中，从而束缚AI的自由发挥？

3、AI生成的工作流、代码，人尽量不要临时插手打局部补丁

她的例子是，如果你发现了一个小问题，有时候我们会因为偷懒（懒得和AI陈述全貌）而直接上手做一些临时性修改。看似性价比很高，实则其实是污染了整个工作流的设计思路。后续再进行AI生产与修改时，AI就会去模仿你的这种短视、劣质的行为，从而带偏整个项目。

content.html:
Perplexity crossed a $1B annual revenue run rate today, CEO Aravind Srinivastold Semaforat a live event.The Informationreported previously under $250M at the start of the year and over $750M by August, with Computer driving some of the growth. At usualagent labmultiples (egCognition also crossed $1B, withCursor crossing $4.6B), this would roughly mean that Perplexity is now worth $30-50B — if the unit economics hold up. This is a nice bump on the$20B round in September 2025, and qualifies for our “>$10B fundraise” rule for title stories.

Gathering up some recent Perplexity launches for those catching up:

  • Computer.September’sAutomationslet it pick up recurring tasks where it left off. November’sTeammatestake on ongoing jobs. Computer also runs fully locally on supported Macs.

  • Monitor API.Watch a topic or pageand get a webhook when something relevant changes.

  • Frontier Research.The newresearch labhas access to 10,000+ GPUs and plans to publish papers, data, models, and code.

Sponsored by Deepgram
Deepgram is the voice AI infrastructure behind natural conversation—bringing speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice-focused LLMs, and agents to teams building with voice AI. For any stack and any tools you already love building with, Deepgram slots in as your foundational voice AI technology. So you have control. And we have the context to listen, understand, and speak like a human.

Learn more about the Real-time Context Standard.

AI Twitter Recap

Qwen4-Max in the wild

Friday’sQwen4-Max previewis now a shipping model. At the highest reasoning setting, Qwen4-Max scored 43 on the Intelligence Index, up from 34. Average cost fell from $10.02 to $3.27 per task. Alibaba cut output pricing from $6 to $4.50 per million tokens, and the model generated about 39% fewer of them. Kimi K3.1 Pro cost $3.68 per index task and scored 67% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 to Qwen’s 48%.Artificial Analysis

  • Inside the model.Alibaba kept the total parameter count at 2.4T and reduced the number active per token by 25% to 71B. The model takes images and text, with a 1M-token context window. Smaller open-weight Qwen4 models are still to come.Alibaba

  • Arena and Vals: Arena ranks it #14 overall on Agent Arena, the top Chinese model, with +7.5% net over 14.7k sessions (Arena).

    • WebDev: It placed #6 in Code Arena WebDev at 1750, +74 over its predecessor (WebDev). It also placed #6 in Image-to-WebDev, just above Claude Opus 5 and GPT-6 Sol (I2WebDev).

  • Vals Index: It is #11 overall, with large gains in coding and finance (Vals).

  • Legal-benchmark caveat: On HLAB it gets 95.7% of checklist items right but passes only 21.3% of tasks, and its output tokens rise 3.6x (HLAB).

  • Vision results (independent): Roboflow calls it underwhelming on its VLM benchmark, with Google, OpenAI and Anthropic now far ahead. At high reasoning effort, however, it is ~4.5x faster and ~68% cheaper per image than Qwen3.8-Max (Roboflow).

    • Safety, alignment and eval integrity

    • OpenAI embedded assessments: OpenAI is giving Apollo, METR, Transluce and Goodfire internal access to its models and systems (OpenAI).

      • Scope by group

items.title: Show HN: Coral – Open-source gateway where agents write their own tools
items.summary: Hi HN, I'm James, one of the co-founders of Coral. Coral is an open-source, self-hosted gateway that sits between your agents and the systems they work on. Agents call tools by writing short TypeScript programs that they can save as custom tools to reuse. You can publish custom tools for groups of agents, so your team…

content.html:
Hi HN, I'm James, one of the co-founders of Coral.

Coral is an open-source, self-hosted gateway that sits between your agents and the systems they work on. Agents call tools by writing short TypeScript programs that they can save as custom tools to reuse.

You can publish custom tools for groups of agents, so your team’s library of tools adapts to your unique systems, data and use cases. Custom tools help agent performance and give more precise units of permission control.

Here’s a short demo:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0PKOlHLyVI

We started on this while building an AI SRE. To investigate an incident, the agent had to connect the dots across an ocean of telemetry data and undocumented relationships across internal and external systems. It took broad permissions, a lot of tokens and it would start from scratch the next time.

We built Coral so that the agent remembers the route. Once a task succeeds, the agent writes the steps that worked into a program and saves it as a custom tool. Next time, the agent finds that custom tool in the same search as standard provider tools (e.g. Datadog, Slack), and reuses it. It started with SRE, but we (and our early users) now use Coral for agent work across the org.

For our tasks across GitHub, Linear and Slack with Opus 5.5, custom tools help agents work 29% faster, at 31% lower cost (tasks here:https://withcoral.com/docs/examples/custom-tools).

Coral builds on code mode, adding custom tools, policy controls and managed identities. Each program runs in a V8 isolate with no network access or credentials. Coral checks every tool call against workspace policy before attaching credentials and forwarding it to the provider. You can configure each provider to use the caller’s own account, so teammates can share tools without sharing API tokens. (e.g.https://withcoral.com/blog/slackbot-works-better-with-coral)

Coral is written in Rust, and you can run it as a desktop app or as a shared server. The core is Apache 2.0 and has no limits on users, agents or volume. Everything I've described here is in the OSS edition. SAML, SCIM, and org-wide governance features will be available soon under an enterprise licence.

We'd love for you to try it and share your feedback. You can download it herehttps://withcoral.com/download.

I'll be in the comments here and on Slack:https://withcoral.com/slack

items.title: Running the full server-side Datasette Python app in the browser with service workers and Pyodide
items.summary: Datasette Lite is my port of the Datasette Python application to run directly in the browser using WebAssembly and Pyodide . I've released a complete rewrite of Datasette Lite using service workers, and it's now almost indistinguishable from the real server-side application. You can now do all of the following, using…

content.html:
Datasette Liteis my port of theDatasettePython application to run directly in the browser using WebAssembly andPyodide. I've released a complete rewrite of Datasette Lite using service workers, and it's now almost indistinguishable from the real server-side application.

You can now do all of the following, using a carefully crafted URL tolite.datasette.io:

  • Load client-side Datasette to browse any SQLite database, JSON file, CSV file or SQL script
  • Select a released version of Datasette to load from PyPI
  • Load a specific commit, tag, or branch name from the Datasette GitHub repository
  • Pick from over 100 versions of SQLite to use with Datasette
  • Install additional Datasette plugins from PyPI or URLs to wheel files, including JavaScript visualization tools

The ability to load specific Datasette references, plugins, and SQLite versions makes this a fantastic tool for linking to demos of work-in-progress features or bug reproductions, without needing to spin up a full web server to serve that demo.

As an example, consider the following URL:

https://lite.datasette.io/?install=datasette-maplibre&url=https://gist.githubusercontent.com/simonw/39fa5d399465766039549912e2b3d291/raw/f6dfba99a75cbb8b5d9386223220eb52272767ee/demo.db&metadata=https://gist.githubusercontent.com/simonw/39fa5d399465766039549912e2b3d291/raw/f6dfba99a75cbb8b5d9386223220eb52272767ee/metadata.yml#/demo/capitals_and_countries%23map=0/4.2/180&color=continent

Follow that link and, after a short loading screen, you'll find yourself on a page that looks like this:

That's Datasette running the newdatasette-maplibreplugin, loading up a database of GeoJSON shapes of countries and displaying both a combined map and individual boundary maps in a table.

Let's break down that URL to see what it's doing:

https://lite.datasette.io/
?install=datasette-maplibre
&url=https://.../demo.db
&metadata=https://.../metadata.yml
#/demo/capitals_and_countries%23map=0/4.2/180&color=continent

The?install=datasette-maplibreinstalls that additional plugin from PyPI. You can pass&install=...as many times as you like to load more plugins.

&url=https://.../demo.dbloads that SQLite database from the provided URL. These URLs need to haveopen CORS headers- I host files like this inGists, because they provide an easy way to get open CORS headers on a web-hosted file.

&metadata=https://.../metadata.ymlloadsthis metadata.yml file. The metadata file adds HTML descriptions to various tables, and to the Datasette homepage. Visitthat homepage herefor a guided tour of the other features of that plugin, all defined in the metadata file.

#/demo/capitals_and_countries%23map=0/4.2/180&color=continentis a fragment hash that turns into a location within Datasette - here it's loading the/demo/capitals_and_countriesSQL view, then appendinganotherfragment hash to it (%23is a URL-encoded#) which tells the map plugin to zoom to a certain location and to set the color of the shapes on the map based on thecontinentcolumn in the data.

That URL is doing a lot of work! I wrote more about this trick for building URL-addressable software inURL-addressable Pyodide Python environments

items.title: Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging
items.summary: We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\colonΣ^\star\toΣ$ from a class $\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on…

content.html: We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\colonΣ^\star\toΣ$ from a class $\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on bootstrap samples of the training data. For binary token sets, it achieves the optimal sample complexity of $O((d_{\mathrm{VC}}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$, independent of the CoT length $T$, where $d_{\mathrm{VC}}$ is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{F}$. For finite token sets $Σ$, the VC dimension is replaced by a multiclass analogue, the Graph dimension $d_{\mathrm{G}}$, and the sample complexity is optimal up to a $\log|Σ|$ factor. The number of generators in the majority-vote ensemble is $O(\log(T/δ))$, and we show that the ensemble can be distilled into a single generator in $\mathcal{F}$ at the expense of $n\log(nT)$ unlabeled prompts.

items.title: TRACE: Topological Representations for Anomaly detection through Contrastive Embeddings
items.summary: Intrusion detectors must recognize evolving malicious behavior even when confirmed attack labels are scarce or incomplete. We present TRACE, a topology-aware graph contrastive learning framework for label-efficient intrusion detection. TRACE learns from benign system-activity graphs by combining message-passing and to…

content.html: Intrusion detectors must recognize evolving malicious behavior even when confirmed attack labels are scarce or incomplete. We present TRACE, a topology-aware graph contrastive learning framework for label-efficient intrusion detection. TRACE learns from benign system-activity graphs by combining message-passing and topological representations, then assigns anomaly scores in the same projected embedding space optimized by the contrastive objective. This design captures both local interactions and graph-scale structural deviations without using attack labels during representation learning. A labeled validation set containing benign and malicious graphs is used only to calibrate the anomaly threshold. We evaluate TRACE on StreamSpot, GraSec-IoT, and Unicorn Wget against a supervised graph neural network and the benign-only GraphCL baseline. TRACE obtains F1 scores of 0.923, 0.790, and 0.583, respectively. Compared with GraphCL, this is higher on StreamSpot (0.450) and Unicorn Wget (0.203), but lower on GraSec-IoT (0.975). The supervised model leads on StreamSpot and GraSec-IoT, whereas TRACE has the highest F1 on Unicorn Wget. The mixed results show that topology-aware benign-only learning can improve detection in some graph settings but does not provide a uniform advantage.

content.html:
Strata 装进 Mac：M5 Ultra 256GB 跑 104G 大模型，外加内网台式机 3080 Ti 12G联动

同机器，Strata 用源码命令行装一遍、官方 dmg 装一遍，再跟 mlx-serve 同题对比。先放结论：

  • 壳的差别就一句话：dmg 装完就能用，源码路线六步 setup。跑起来是同一个引擎，速度没有差别。
  • 大内存机上，流式惩罚消失：128GB 机器上 prefill 慢 3–4 倍，256GB 机器收窄到 1.6 倍。
  • 跟 mlx-serve 对比：decode 打平、prefill 慢 1.6 倍、质量 5 题全过。没有任何一维赢，换引擎无收益——路径探索到此闭环。

测试环境

项值
机型Mac Studio，M5 Ultra 36 核，256GB 统一内存
模型unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF，UD-Q4_K_XL 档，104GB 四分片
引擎Strata 0.2.15（app）+ engine 0.1.60-macos-arm64-metal
对照mlx-serve，同机常驻，4.7bpw 同家族模型

两条安装路，都走通了

源码路线：clone →setup.sh，依次干七件事（Python 检查、编 Metal 引擎、下模型、对 sha256、pack 打包、MTP 草稿层、起服务）。全脚本可自动化，适合无人值守。注意 pack 产物 85GB，磁盘要留够。

dmg 路线：装 app → 界面选模型自动下载 → 自动 pack、自动拉引擎组件、自动生成实例 api_key。视觉投影和 DFlash2 草稿层都是界面里点选。装完就能用。

装完核验：dmg sha256 对官方 SHA256SUMS 逐字符一致；spctl报 accepted, Notarized Developer ID。

磁盘账：共 183GB（模型 104GB + pack + 草稿层）。

app 版真实负载 4 小时：90 条请求的账

app 起服务后接进 agent 链路当日常大脑跑了 4 小时，引擎日志留下 90 条真实请求——不是跑分脚本，是长会话真实流量：

指标读数
decode中位 117 tok/s，波动带 48–200
投机解码接受率69.2%（77,182 / 111,531 草稿，MTP + DFlash2）
prefill 冷读均值 ~2.8K，峰值 3.4K tok/s
缓存命中67K 长会话滚到下一轮，221ms 吃完（复用 67K，只读增量 437）
最长会话prompt 67.7K token
驻留全加载后还剩 154,918 MiB 空闲显存，80 个专家常驻（R4 hit path ON）

两条值得单说：

  1. 前缀缓存是长会话的胜负手。agent 负载每轮只增几百 token，命中时 prefill 几乎免费——"上下文越堆越慢"在这套组合上不成立。
  2. 69.2% 投机接受率是真实流量攒的，直接解释 decode 波动带上沿为什么能冲到 200。

跟 mlx-serve 同题对拉

同脚本、temperature=0、usage 回读：

指标Strata UD-Q4_K_XLmlx-serve 4.7bpw判词
decode 热身（512 tok ×3）108 / 133 / 133109 / 115 / 145波动带重叠，打平
prefill 42K（破缓存 ×2）3.2–3.5K tok/s5.6K tok/sStrata 慢 1.6×
短请求 TTFT1–2 ms1–2 ms平
质量 5 题（含代码实跑判卷）55平（n=5）

双引擎共存账：mlx-serve 大脑常驻 + Strata 全驻，memory_pressure 49% free，swap 仅 579MB。256GB 扛两套无压力；小内存机器别照抄这条。

局域网那台 3080 Ti：接入、跑况与用法

Mac 之外，家里还有一台 RTX 3080 Ti 12G老台式机，内存四通道64G（16*4）跑 Strata q2_0（n_ctx 65536，推理模型），走反向隧道接进来。定位：它是隔离面，不是提速面——decode 60–75 tok/s 比本机慢，收益是把粗加工（分类、摘要、改写、批量生成）从本机 GPU 挪开，让本机大脑专注主会话。

11-15 全量矩阵实测定稿的用法：

  • 甜点区：业务输入 ≤35K、输出 ≤8K、单发短会话，响应 10–25s。
  • 派活走 API：任务书自带全部材料，一发一收，结果落盘。DSH 界面手动切台式机只限"新窗口 + 新会话 + 单话题短用"，不堆长对话。
  • 严格串行：并发就是排队，队头阻塞实测 36s。长任务在跑时别插短请求指望即时响应。
  • 禁派计数和多步算术——两边模型都不可信，计算交代码执行。
  • 关机即全断，断得干净：连接拒绝 0.2 毫秒返回，不挂死、不重试风暴、本机零波及。没有自愈，恢复靠对侧重新拉隧道——符合"不常驻、纯手动"的设计。

边界

  1. 质量卷 n=5，只能说"无肉眼可见差异"，不是"质量等价"。
  2. 速度读数全部来自单台 256GB M5 Ultra；16–24GB 机器是流式加载的主场，数字不搬。
  3. 90 条请求是 agent 型负载（长会话、高缓存命中），换聊天型短请求画像会不同。
  4. 台式机数据是 11-15 单轮矩阵，n=1 定稿，后续波动未跟踪。

  • 主题图与插图：本机双引擎生图（封面与数据板 H3，运行环境 Qwen-Image-2.1）

content.html:
昨天出差贵阳，行程比较紧张，临时远程连家里机器生成了两段。

同一个驱动脚本，2D 和 3D 各一条，1344×768 / 12.00 秒 / 单条直出，不拼接、无二次编码。

2D 动画版：https://youtu.be/94McV1anMCY

3D CGI 版：https://youtu.be/XD2d_HzkBjo

一、这条片子讲了什么

十二秒，五镜：

时间内容
0–3s剑心前脚往石板上搓起一蓬沙石，直接糊进志志雄眼睛，趁他睁不开眼贴上去砍：上挑斜斩 + 反手斩
3–6s志志雄擦亮眼睛暴起反击，四连击（下劈 / 刺 / 火焰横扫 / 再下劈），两人在胸口高度对砍
6–8s剑心抢出全场最快的高中低三连斩，全被架住，反被震退半步，汗珠甩飞——久攻不下
8–10s单手架着刀，另一只手伸进衣襟，掏出一把银色沙漠之鹰，拇指压开保险
10–12s单臂开火，枪口焰照亮半个庭院，志志雄被掀翻、火焰刀脱手，剑心举枪站着，枪口一缕烟

没写"剑气大战"，也没让两人满场跑——全程贴在一刀距离内，靠腰、肩、手臂和刀转。

二、硬件

项值
显卡NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada Generation 48G（单卡）
系统Ubuntu，CUDA
ComfyUI0.39.0，bf16 文本编码
出片方式294 帧一次生成 → 裁到 288 帧 = 12.00 秒，无拼接、无二次编码

三、规格

  • 分辨率1344×768，24fps，288 帧 =12.00 秒
    （H3 是 17k+5 网格，出 294 帧；尾部 5 帧用ImageFromBatch裁掉，音频用TrimAudioDuration同步裁到 12.00s）
  • 参考图六张，2D 与 3D 混用：
    • <Picture 1~3>剑心：2D 动画全身 / 2D 脸部特写 / 3D 手办
  • <Picture 4~6>志志雄：2D 立绘全身 / 3D 手办 / 3D 火场
  • ref_image_size = match
  • 音轨由 H3 原生联合生成（脚步、搓沙、金属碰撞、火焰、枪声），不是后期配的

    • 混用的原因：2D 图的脸最准（脸部特写清晰），3D 手办给的是材质和体块。只喂纯 3D 手办时剑心的脸会被拉成"通用动漫帅哥"，加上 2D 脸特写之后 X 刀疤和眼型就回来了。

    四、工作流

    官方 Ref2VA 路线：

    UNETLoader(Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_int8)
→ LoraLoaderModelOnly(pika_h3_flex_ref2va, 1.0)
→ LoraLoaderModelOnly(H3_Fight_Flow_V1, 0.9)
→ LoraLoaderModelOnly(H3_Combat_V2, 0.9)
→ LoraLoaderModelOnly(Motion_Repair, 0.7)
→ ModelAttentionBackend(comfy kitchen attention)
→ BasicGuider
CLIPLoader(qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot)
VAELoader(video fp16) + VAELoader(audio fp32)
LoadImage × 6 → MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo → LATENT
RandomNoise → KSamplerSelect(lcm) → SigmasFromList(七值) → SamplerCustomAdvanced
→ VAEDecode + VAEDecodeAudio
→ ImageFromBatch(288) + TrimAudioDuration(12.0) → CreateVideo(24fps) → SaveVideo
    项文件
    底模Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_int8.safetensors（31.7G 完整版）
    文本编码器qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
    VAEminimax_h3_video_vae_fp16/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32
    加速 LoRApika_h3_flex_ref2va_comfy_bf16@1.0
    动作 LoRAH3_Fight_Flow_V1@0.9、H3_Combat_V2@0.9、Motion_Repair@0.7

    **工作流 JSON **：
    wf_2D_final.json
    wf_3D_final.json

    五、加速手段

    手段具体
    Pika 六步蒸馏KSamplerSelect(lcm)+SigmasFromList七值1.0, 0.972973, 0.923077, 0.8, 0.571429, 0.333333, 0.0
    SageAttention启动加--use-sage-attention
    Kitchen INT8 注意力ModelAttentionBackend = comfy kitchen attention
    int8 convrot主模型与 32B 文本编码器均 int8 量化
    说明不叠turbo / DMAD / VBVR / lightx2v —— Pika 本身六步蒸馏，叠了会破坏 sigma 调度

    单条 294 帧端到端474 / 491 秒（含 31.7G 模型加载、六张参考图编码、采样、VAE 解码与落盘）。

    六、运行时间

    片开始完成Total
    2D13:20:0813:28:03474.35 s
    3D13:31:4613:39:57490.88 s

content.html:
AI日报 11/18

今日 4 条，均为 2026-11-18（Asia/Shanghai）当天发布：国产芯片适配、OpenAI 算力多元化、谷歌 Agent 免费、AI 投行融资。

1. 寒武纪 Day 0 适配商汤 SenseNova Loop-9B

  • 商汤发布 SenseNova Loop-9B，用 Loop 结构把 32 个物理解码层扩展为 56 次层计算；4bit 量化权重约 4.9GB，显存需求低至 10GB 内。
  • 寒武纪基于 vllm_mlu 完成 Day 0 适配，围绕 Loop 循环层展开、MLU 算子替换与 mHC 路由优化，打通 MLU 平台推理链路。

来源：IT之家

2. OpenAI 推进与 AMD 合作，首个 neocloud 落地

  • OpenAI 公布 AMD 6GW 算力协议的首家 neocloud 合作方 TensorWave，将在美国多个数据中心提供 457MW 容量，约占协议总容量 7.6%。
  • 同时 OpenAI 还在自研 “Jalapeño” 芯片并计划采购 Google TPU，以降低对英伟达的依赖。

来源：Fortune

3. 谷歌把 Spark AI Agent 改名 Tasks 并免费开放

  • Google 将 Spark AI 助手重塑为 “Tasks”，向所有 Gemini 用户免费开放。
  • 美国用户还将获得让 Gemini 代打电话、用 Google Pay 结账等能力。

来源：The Verge

4. Model ML 完成 2.5 亿美元 B 轮，估值 15 亿美元

  • 伦敦初创 Model ML 用 AI Agent 自动完成投行/咨询的财务建模、Pitch Deck 和尽调报告，获 2.5 亿美元 B 轮，估值 15 亿美元。
  • 本轮由 General Atlantic 与老股东共同领投。

来源：TechCrunch

content.html:
<details open>

cuda: use the implicit GEMM conv2d path for F32 kernels (#32482)

The fast CONV_2D path (implicit GEMM with MMA, or cuBLAS for pointwise convolutions) required an F16 kernel. F32 kernels fell back to the naive direct convolution, which is much slower than im2col + mul_mat on large channel counts.

Convert F32 kernels to F16 in a pool buffer, as is already done for the input, and take the same path with F32 accumulation. The Metal implicit GEMM kernel already stages both operands as F16.

</details>

items.summary: I type "forklift" on a live warehouse camera, and tamserve finds and tracks both forklifts, including the one driving in. Then I add "person" without stopping it. tamserve runs Meta's SAM 3 on live camera feeds. SAM 3's own tracker handles one recorded video at a time, runs at about 8 fps, and runs out of memory on lo…

content.html:
I type "forklift" on a live warehouse camera, and tamserve finds and tracks both forklifts, including the one driving in. Then I add "person" without stopping it.

tamserve runs Meta's SAM 3 on live camera feeds. SAM 3's own tracker handles one recorded video at a time, runs at about 8 fps, and runs out of memory on long videos. tamserve uses SAM 3 to find objects every few frames and a lightweight tracker (EdgeTAM) to follow them in between, with one copy of each model shared across all your cameras.

*On one RTX 4090:*

* *Any object you name:* 4x faster than SAM 3's tracker, at 92% of its accuracy * *People:* 16 cameras at once, 14x less GPU per frame, and slightly more accurate than SAM 3 (89.6 vs 87.8 HOTA) * *Memory:* flat at 3.5 GB on a 3,000 frame video, where SAM 3 runs out at frame 423

*Worth a look if you're building:*

* Warehouse or factory safety (forklifts, pallets, hard hats) * Security or retail camera analytics * Home or elder care monitoring * Robotics, wildlife or lab monitoring * Annotation tools for long videos

`pip install "tamserve[sam3]"`

Please give me any and all feedback or edit tamserve to meet your needs, and a star helps if you find it useful!

items.title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
items.summary: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We charact…

content.html: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
items.summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn…

content.html: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.

content.html:
📄 Paperless-AI

![GitHub commit activity](https://github.com/clusterzx/paperless-ai/commits/main)![Docker Pulls](https://hub.docker.com/r/clusterzx/paperless-ai)![GitHub Stars](https://github.com/clusterzx)![License](LICENSE)

Paperless-AIis an AI extension forPaperless-ngx. It analyzes your documents and fills in title, tags, correspondent, document type, date and custom fields – and lets youask questions about your whole archivein natural language, with answers that cite their sources.

Works withPaperless-ngx 2.x and 3.x, OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude),Ollama (fully local), Azure OpenAI and every OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, vLLM, LM Studio, Gemini, Together, Perplexity, …).

> [!IMPORTANT] >Security notice for 3.x:in all Paperless-AI versions before 4.0, the setup wizard can be used without logging in. Anyone who can reach such an instance can replace its user account and its configuration (Paperless token, AI provider), and this is being exploited.Update to 4.0– it is not affected. If your 3.x instance was reachable from the internet, read [Upgrading from 3.x](#upgrading-from-3x) before you migrate.

> 💡 Just ask: > “When did I sign my rental agreement?” > “What was the amount of the last electricity bill?” > “Which documents mention my health insurance?”

![Dashboard](docs/screenshots/dashboard.png)

---

✨ What's new in 4.1

  • OCR with PaddleOCR– scans, photos and documents with garbled text are read locally (PP-OCRv5 via ONNX Runtime, no extra container, models ~20 MB). Runs automatically *before* the AI analysis – for documents without text, with poor text or always – or on demand. → [OCR](#ocr)
  • OCR page– every document with a text-quality score, filters for missing/poor text, bulk OCR, side-by-side comparison of the Paperless text and the OCR result. Afterwards the AI names and tags the documents again.
  • Better text in Paperless too– the OCR result can replace the document text in Paperless (improves the Paperless full-text search), with undo.
  • GPU image–clusterzx/paperless-ai:latest-cudaruns OCR on NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA 13);lateststays the small CPU image for amd64 and arm64. → [Image variants](#-installation)
  • Prompt wizard– a few questions instead of prompt engineering: your own name (never used as correspondent), output language, title style or pattern, tags, short company names, document types and own rules. Live preview and a test on real documents before saving.
  • Privacy– the usage telemetry of ONNX Runtime (OCR and local embeddings) is switched off.

✨ What's new in 4.0 – a complete rewrite

Version 4 is rebuilt from scratch with a focus on reliability, speed and low resource usage.

| | 3.x | 4.0 | | --- | --- | --- | | Architecture | Node.js + separate Python service (Torch, ChromaDB, NLTK) | One Node.js process (TypeScript) | | Docker image | several GB |~135 MBcompressed | | RAM in idle | 1–2 GB |≈ 80–150 MB(embedding model loaded on demand) | | RAG retrieval | one embedding of the first ~100 words per document |chunked passages, hybridBM25 + vectorsearch, metadata boosts | | RAG answers | not streamed, no references |streamed,cited sources[1], follow-up questions | | Index updates | full re-crawl & re-embed |incremental(changed/deleted documents only) | | Settings | written to.env, container restart required | validated,applied instantly– no restart | | Paperless-ngx | 2.x |2.x and 3.x(API version negotiated automatically, verified against 2.14, 2.20 and 3.2) | | Undo | only “forget processing state” |real undo– restores the original values in Paperless | | Interface | server-rendered pages |new design: single-page app, command menu, light/dark + accent colours |

Upgrading from 3.x is automatic: yourdata/.env, user account, processing state, history and token statistics are migrated on first start (the old files are kept untouched) – see [Upgrading from 3.x](#upgrading-from-3x).

🚀 Features

Automatic processing

Windows 上 Hermes / DeepSeek Harness 无法启动 —— 排障记录

前言：

前些日子一直使用的好好的，更新下了腾讯管家，Hermes / DeepSeek Harness 通通无法启动，本来使用两个工具是可以互相拿来修复，一下全挂了，只能和另一台电脑的hermes通过聊天方式慢慢排查。困扰了两天，真没想到是这个原因。如果有遇到相同问题的兄弟可以借鉴一二。

记录日期：2026-11-17
环境：Windows 10/11 台式机（公司内网），Hermes Agent v0.23.1（git 安装），DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.3
结论：腾讯电脑管家的网络防护驱动拦截了特定进程的 IPv4 回环连接，导致 Pythonsocketpair()死锁，进而使依赖 asyncio 的客户端全部卡在启动阶段。

一、现象

时间表现
最初ping 127.0.0.1返回"一般故障"，4 发 0 收
同期DeepSeek Harness 启动报ETIMEDOUT 127.0.0.1:<随机端口>（8941 / 5907 / 13620 等，每次不同）
同期Hermes 启动卡住无响应，界面出不来或一直转圈
中间执行sfc /scannow后ping 127.0.0.1恢复，但两个客户端仍无法使用

二、排查过程（按阶段）

阶段 1：确认回环 TCP 是否真的修复

ping走的是 ICMP，与 TCP 是两条独立路径，ping 恢复不代表 TCP 恢复。

# TCP 环回测试
$p = Start-Process python -ArgumentList "-m","http.server","8899","--bind","127.0.0.1" -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Sleep 2
$r = Test-NetConnection 127.0.0.1 -Port 8899
"TCP环回: TcpTestSucceeded=$($r.TcpTestSucceeded)"
Stop-Process $p.Id -Force

结果：TcpTestSucceeded=True（当时 IPv4/IPv6 都通），说明网络栈层面已恢复。

阶段 2：确认客户端进程状态

Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'hermes|dsh|DeepSeek'} | Select Name,Id
Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object {$_.LocalAddress -match '127.0.0.1|0.0.0.0|::'} |
Select LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Sort LocalPort

发现：进程起来了，但监听端口列表里没有任何端口属于这些进程—— 进程活着却没建立起本地服务。

阶段 3：逐层验证服务端（模型网关）

客户端连的是自建的 HTTPS 网关（经反向隧道转发到家里的推理服务）。逐层验证：

# 1) 公司出口能否连到网关端口
(Test-NetConnection <网关IP> -Port 9443 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue).TcpTestSucceeded
# 2) 网关是否正常应答（不带 key 预期 401）
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "code=%{http_code} verify=%{ssl_verify_result}`n" https://<网关域名>:9443/v1/models
# 3) 证书是否有效
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "verify=%{ssl_verify_result}`n" https://<网关域名>:9443/v1/models

结果：

TCP : True
HTTP : 401（0.168s） ← 网关正常，只是没带 key
TLS verify : 0 ← 证书链完整有效

再看网关的访问日志，确认客户端有没有真的发请求过来 ——发现 Hermes 自己发过一条并拿到了 200：

<公司出口IP> - - "GET /v1/models HTTP/1.1" 200 242 "-" "hermes-cli/0.23.1"

=> 网络、证书、API Key 全部正常，问题不在服务端。

阶段 4：读客户端日志，定位卡在哪一步

& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\hermes\bin\hermes.exe" logs errors
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\hermes\bin\hermes.exe" logs --since 30m

关键错误（每 5 分半循环一次，持续一整天）：

CRITICAL hermes_startup_watchdog: Gateway startup did not reach a live event loop
within 300s (elapsed 300s, 0 extension(s)), holds no progress lease and shows no
CPU progress; dumping all thread stacks and exiting with code 75 (OOF-298).

日志最后一行为Plugin discovery complete: 62 found, 58 enabled后再无输出。

"no CPU progress"是关键线索 —— 不是慢，是阻塞在等待（I/O 或网络）。

阶段 5：看线程栈，找到真实卡点

看门狗已把线程栈 dump 到日志目录：

Get-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\hermes\logs\gateway-startup-watchdog.log" -Tail 40

栈顶（主线程）：

socket.py line 298 in accept
socket.py line 633 in _fallback_socketpair
asyncio\proactor_events.py in _make_self_pipe
asyncio\windows_events.py in __init__
asyncio\runners.py line 204 in run
hermes_cli\gateway.py 4529 in run_gateway
hermes_cli\main.py in main

卡在 Windows 上 asyncio 创建事件循环的socketpair()。

阶段 6：对照实验，判断是系统问题还是进程问题

Windows 没有原生socketpair，CPython 的兜底实现是：
监听127.0.0.1:<随机端口>→ 自己连自己 →accept()。任一步不通，accept()就永久阻塞。

用两个不同的 Python做同样的自连测试：

# Hermes 自带的 Python
$py = (Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\hermes\tools" -Directory |
Where-Object {$_.…

items.title: Maintainers don’t need more AI bug reports. They need fixes.
items.summary: AI has made finding potential vulnerabilities fast and cheap. Fixing them still takes human judgment, and in open source, that work falls to maintainers. Many are already flooded with AI-generated security findings, including duplicates and reports that aren’t vulnerabilities at all. Another raw scan doesn’t help them…

content.html:
AI has made finding potential vulnerabilities fast and cheap. Fixing them still takes human judgment, and in open source, that work falls to maintainers. Many are already flooded with AI-generated security findings, including duplicates and reports that aren’t vulnerabilities at all. Another raw scan doesn’t help them. Anyone pointing a new model at a project should ask its maintainers first and come with fixes, not just findings.

Maintainers are under intense pressure from this flood of reports. As Christian Grobmeier, a maintainer of Log4j, has put it, theAI defending open source has to be better than the AI attacking it.

AI shouldn’t add to maintainers’ workload. So, with maintainers, GitHub and Microsoft ran a pilot together: could AI help maintainers ship fixes instead of handing them more findings?

GitHub and Microsoft are usingCodename MDASH, Microsoft’s multi-model agentic scanning harness, to find and fix security vulnerabilities in widely used open source software, strengthening the foundation that much of the world’s code is built on.

The process

Our pilot had two goals: send only findings that matter, and never send a maintainer an unverified finding. Here’s how it worked:

  1. Find.Codename MDASH, an AI system from Microsoft Security, scanned each project using Microsoft’sMAI Cyber modeland suggested fixes for what it found.
  2. Filter.AnAI triage agent from the GitHub Security Lab, built on tailored Copilot skills, removed duplicates, checked validity, and focused on high-impact bugs, so maintainers never had to review raw scan results.
  3. Verify.Researchers from Microsoft FORGE Labchecked every remaining finding by hand.
  4. Report privately.Reports reached maintainers through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, with a proof of concept and a suggested fix.
  5. Fix.Maintainers decided what to fix, how to fix it, and when.

Reports and fixes stayed on GitHub, where maintainers already work.

The result: Codename MDASH, using Microsoft’s MAI Cyber model, flagged thousands of possible issues across the six projects. After AI triage and hand review by seven Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers, maintainers received 99 private reports. As of November 15, they had fixed 55, and 14 of those fixes were already in a release.

What we learned

These lessons come from what the six projects fixed and what their maintainers chose to share. Six projects is a small sample, so read them as early lessons.

1. Fixes matter more than findings

Fixing is where maintainers spend their time. So every report arrived already checked, with a suggested fix to review, adapt, and merge. Maintainers started from a well-scoped patch, not a raw finding.

The first fixes shipped about a week after the initial scan. Caddy’s maintainers fixed all 22 of the reports they received in a week or less. Maintainers used the suggested fixes, some as written and some with changes.

AutoGPT’s maintainers had recently shipped a new check, and it was broken. The report landed three days later and pointed at the right line. They took the fix further than the suggested patch, wrote it within a day, and had it in production less than a week later.

content.html:
白居易在《琵琶行》中怎么说的？千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面。我们论坛的大神@ivan-lan，也是新来的哥们，土豪一个。他就买了一个M5 Ultra 512G，说要挑战我们论坛大神的DGX Spark，四台1V4看看效果如何。跑的版本是DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017。

然后我们看一下挑战的帖子。我们论坛的@benton-yi老兄发过两个帖子，编号是2946，大家可以找一下，原始的母帖地址也在这里，点一下就可以去看。他是4个DGX Spark，没有使用交换机，使用的是环形拓扑，就一个简单的拓扑结构。跑的推理框架叫SparkRing，是vLLM的一个分支，上面好像自带一个Benchmark，跑的就是DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。他之前跑的是老版本，最近发的帖子是8天前发的，跑的是1017版本，也是最新版本。

然后他当时测试的结果，我们简单总结一下，就是相当牛逼。他当时好像跑了10路、512K上下文，是可以扛住的。10路有点极限了，可能会有点掉速，那么8路是非常从容的，上下文可以拉满，而且它的吞吐、延迟、Prefill速度都相当牛逼。你看上下文从最短到512K，它都发出了明确的数据，无论是Prefill还是Decode，体验都相当不错，大家可以参考一下。讲实话，这个4台DGX Spark的方案做好了，体验跟官方在线API的差距基本微乎其微，可以平替它。而且它跑的就是官方原版的NVFP4和FP8混合版本，所以它吃到了所有红利。

这个方案他当时买的时候是4台，大概花了13万左右，前面两台便宜一点，后面两台贵一点。现在这个方案可能值20万，20万出头，就跟苹果的M5 Ultra差不多了。其实到了20万级别，或者20万以上，这点差价对于这些土豪来讲基本可以忽略不计。那么Ivan Lan到货之后又整了一下进度，毕竟有些软件要对齐一下，最起码Benchmark要对齐嘛。但是你看他也发了自己的主机信息，还有工作环境，一看就是个土豪。他怕大家等急了，就先发了个版本，大概信息都给到了，但是没有达到帖子关注度所期望的那样。我觉得发得有点拉，可能以后单独发一个帖子吧。

总体来说，我们想要的信息其实都有了。他现在测试的是单台M5 Ultra Studio，M5 Ultra 512G版本，跑的也是DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017，只不过跑的是MLX适配版本。这个也是完整版，不是阉割版，你看权重就知道了，是Q4 MXFP4版本。那个Benton Yi老哥跑的是官方版本。推理引擎的话，M5 Ultra上面跑的是MLX Serve这个新的推理引擎。我们论坛另外一个有M5 Ultra 256G版本的CC Tgo老兄也推荐用MLX Serve这个推理引擎。

测试方法我觉得也是比较科学的，两轮测试取中位数，这个比较公平。而且他是苹果平台来适配我们Benton Yi老兄的英伟达平台Benchmark，数据非常有参考性。直接上结果吧，他自己也总结了：单流并发的时候，M5 Ultra 512G相当于4台DGX Spark的93.48%；并发相当于62.7%；16并发相当于52.8%。这个作为M5这个机器来讲，我觉得已经值回票价了。毕竟它不仅仅可以跑AI，现在跑视频也是可以的，然后办公各方面它都是一个全能的机器。这个机器再过三五年再卖，还是很值钱。Spark后期可能残值稍微低一点，但是它是Blackwell架构，踩到了NVFP4这个比较重要的红利，也包括FP8。DeepSeek、GLM等等开源大模型，在未来很长一段时间还是会非常好地适配这个生态，所以残值我个人觉得还是可以的，虽然不能跟苹果比。

那么总体上来讲，英伟达的方案是更有性价比，但是苹果胜在逼格，胜在通用。这个Prefill，冷启动Prefill也可以看出来，还是4台DGX Spark领先，分别是1.47倍、1.20倍、1.16倍。然后我们再说一下跑ComfyUI，现在有h3.c，@cc-tgo也发了不少测试视频，也分享了工作流，大家可以去找CC Tgo老兄的帖子。现在在M5 Ultra、M5 Max上面都可以跑。哦，对了，M5 Max也有人测试，这位叫@fsclsnow 的兄弟用的是M5 Max 64GB，他也能跑，效率还不错。当然Ultra肯定要牛逼得多，但是Ultra可能比单台DGX Spark跑视频快。不过毕竟要对比方案的话，这个价格只能对比4个DGX Spark。在并行生产的时候，还是4个DGX Spark更有性价比，毕竟英伟达的优化就不用多提了。

而且从跑出来的效果来讲，我们必须说，h3.c跑出来的视频效果有点拉。它在动作比较激烈的时候，有肉眼能看出来的马赛克效应。当然了，我个人认为可能跟推理引擎本身的优化状态有关系。苹果的生态太好了，这个问题以后应该比较容易解决。不过从硬性的算力上来讲，M5 Max比DGX Spark算力要差。M5 Ultra就是两个Spark，大概相当于两个DGX Spark的算力。如果跟4个DGX Spark比并行任务，它天然是落后的。

但是论坛这些土豪们、这些大神们，都是比较倾向于苹果方案。为什么呢？因为逼格比较高，一个小盒子放到桌子上，非常安静，这么高逼格的小主机谁不想拥有呢？包括我在内，我也希望有个M5 Ultra。但是贫穷让我安分守己，我摸一摸自己的肾，也只剩下一个了。唉，就这样吧。我从Bunsei老兄那里整了个二手硬件，比新的毕竟便宜一些。但我认真看了一下价格，Bunsei老兄你给我的价格也不是很优惠啊。我以为凭借我们的感情，能够有相当大的优惠，没想到终究还是一场交易。好吧，缘分就到这里了，我也比较悲伤。

最近大家发了很多优秀的帖子，我就躺平。我不是说了嘛，我准备把镇上的房子好好弄一弄，现在还在交割中，里面还住着人家。交割之后还要稍微装修一下。我本人对于环境的要求不是很高，去镇上住有好处，就是能有独立的机房，把服务器放到里面就不那么吵了。然后一个人搭拍摄场景，搭配不同的拍摄环境也比较方便，而且我不用担心家里人在客厅走来走去会吵到我。

等我忙完之后，肯定还是那句话，先把ComfyUI的生态给它搞起来。最近论坛的ComfyUI生态如火如荼，非常不错，形势非常好。大模型呢，我也会抽时间展示一些自动工作流，因为我要给大家展示使用AI为主力、然后我自己参与审核的这么一种方式，做一个新的频道，并且赚到钱，全程直播。欢迎大家关注，也欢迎大家到论坛发帖交流讨论。有什么好的项目能够一起做的，我们论坛这些高等级的大神、高设备的大神，有什么项目、有什么交易需求都可以提出来。

比如说你就想单纯体验一下M5 Ultra 256G或者512G，可以问一下，到论坛问一问CC Tgo，问一问刚才这位大神，看看他们租不租。Ivan也可以问问，看看他们愿不愿意在闲暇的时候跟你分享一下、出租一下，这些都可以。以后我会开发更多功能，方便大家交流资源。我也会去买一些账号、买一些订阅计划，来分享给论坛的高积分用户，不会让你们的积分只有荣誉价值，它会有实际现实的意义。

content.html:
MiniMax-H3 参赛片：注意力改 BF16 + 去掉 turbo 加速 LoRA 的详细测试

日期：2026-11-17机器：magic629-AI（2× Radeon AI PRO R9700 32G，ROCm 7.14，TP2）
服务：radiance-h3fullref（radiance 1.17.0 分支radiance-h3-fullref，端口 8001）
规格：1344×768 / 294 帧 / 24 fps / 12.25 s / seed 145 / 统一 prompt + 6 张参考图（剑心、志志雄）
测试矩阵：3D CGI 与 2D 动画两条片 × 4 / 8 / 20 / 50 步 = 8 条，另加 1 条 int8 对照

0. 结论速览

问题实测答案
注意力改 BF16 后画质变了吗？基本没变。同 seed 同 prompt 的严格 A/B：相对锐度 −3.1%、高频能量比 −0.3%、静止区抖动 +0.1%、宽窗对齐抖动 −3.4%，全部在噪声量级。
那代价是什么？每个去噪步慢 38%（4 步档 47.4→65.6 s/步，20 步档 56.6→78.2 s/步）。而且这还是在"顺手省掉了 LoRA 显存槽"之后测出来的，纯注意力开销只会更大。
去掉 turbo LoRA 后 4 步还能用吗？不能。4 步出片是一团糊（帧 250 整幅是火焰糊块），静止区抖动 3.40，是 turbo 8 步（1.75）的 1.9 倍。
那要几步才够？8 步勉强、20 步进入平台、50 步只有 2D 还在变好。3D 组 20→50 步静止区抖动 2.293→2.316（不降反微升），多花 2.5 倍时间买不到东西。
和现在参赛的 int8+turbo 8 步比呢？同一步数下基模全面落后：8 步静止区抖动 2.526 vs 1.752（差 44%），相对锐度 0.039 vs 0.102。基模要 20 步才接近 turbo 8 步的观感，但时间从 585 s 涨到 1672 s（2.9 倍）。
建议怎么交？规则允许加速 LoRA 就继续int8+fp8 + turbo 8 步；不允许就用int8 20 步（1218 s，画质与 bf16 20 步同级但快 27%）；bf16 只在需要排查量化伪影时用，且步数选 20 不选 50。

1. 这次到底改了什么

1.1 注意力精度：int8 QK + fp8 P·V → BF16 QK + BF16 P·V

DiT 里每层注意力的算子attn_prefix_self有两个精度参数：qk（出厂i8，分数 int8）和pv（出厂fp8）。 libr4d 内核attn_prefix_self_h128_bf16一行支持全部四种组合，所以只需要在算子声明处按环境变量切换：

  • 补丁：opt11-attn-bf16.py→/home/magic629/radiance-h3-fullref/arch/minimaxh3/minimaxh3.cpp（源码备份minimaxh3.cpp.bak-attnbf16）
  • 开关：static bool h3_attn_bf16()读RAD_H3_ATTN=="bf16"；为真时不再声明k_i8 / k_scale / v_fp8 / v_scale四个量化操作数（多传会RAD_E_INVAL），改发RAD_STR("qk","bf16"), RAD_STR("pv","bf16")，Q/K/V 直接吃m.b_qkv
  • 与 VSA 互斥：attn_bf16 && m.vsa直接返回RAD_E_INVAL

怎么确认它真的生效了（这一步差点踩坑，见 §6.7）：

  1. 启动日志出现[h3] DiT attention: BF16 Q.K and BF16 P.V (RAD_H3_ATTN=bf16)
  2. 声明算子数从1836 → 1736，正好少 2 个量化算子 × 50 个 DiT block
    • pid 2139994（bf16）："39 of 1736 declared ops"
  3. pid 2140394（int8）："41 of 1836 declared ops"

1.2 去掉 turbo 加速 LoRA

新增 drop-in/etc/systemd/system/radiance-h3fullref.service.d/96-attn-bf16-nolora.conf：ExecStart=复位后重写启动行，删掉--lora/--max-loras/--max-lora-rank，请求体里也pop掉loras。显存预算沿用 11-16 基线的--host-pool-mib 12288 --gpu-headroom-mib 4096，便于逐步对比。

带 LoRA 槽（11-16 基线）无 LoRA（本次）
vram_weights预算11.31 GiB12.12 GiB（+0.81 GiB）
静态常驻显存5.39 GiB6.29 GiB（+0.90 GiB）
pinned pool 槽位7570

也就是说：去掉 LoRA 反而让引擎多常驻了 0.9 GiB 权重、少了一批 offload 换入换出。本次 bf16 是带着这点便宜还比 int8 慢 38%，纯注意力的代价只会比 38% 更大。

服务 ： radiance-h3fullref （radiance 1.17.0 分支 radiance-h3-fullref ，端口 8001）

0. 结论速览
问题
实测答案
注意力改 BF16 后画质变了吗？
基本没变 。同 seed 同 prompt 的严格 A/B：相对锐度 −3.1%、高频能量比 −0.3%、静止区抖动 +0.1%、宽窗对齐抖动 −3.4%，全部在噪声量级。
那代价是什么？
每个去噪步慢 38% （4 步档 47.4→65.6 s/步，20 步档 56.6→78.2 s/步）。而且这还是在"顺手省掉了 LoRA 显存槽"之后测出来的，纯注意力开销只会更大。
去掉 turbo LoRA 后 4 步还能用吗？
不能 。4 步出片是一团糊（帧 250 整幅是火焰糊块），静止区抖动 3.40，是 turbo 8 步（1.75）的 1.9 倍。
那要几步才够？
8 步勉强、20 步进入平台、50 步只有 2D 还在变好 。3D 组 20→50 步静止区抖动 2.293→2.316（不降反微升），多花 2.5 倍时间买不到东西。
和现在参赛的 int8+turbo 8 步比呢？
同一步数下基模全面落后：8 步静止区抖动 2.526 vs 1.752（差 44%），相对锐度 0.039 vs 0.102。基模要 20 步才接近 turbo 8 步的观感，但时间从 585 s 涨到 1672 s（2.9 倍）。
建议怎么交？
规则允许加速 LoRA 就继续 int8+fp8 + turbo 8 步 ；不允许就用 int8 20 步 （1218 s，画质与 bf16 20 步同级但快 27%）；bf16 只在需要排查量化伪影时用，且步数选 20 不选 50。
