content.html:
GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol

OpenAI:

We’re introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra, our new frontier model for your hardest projects, and GPT‑6.2 Sol, our efficient, versatile model for everyday work.

They're available in the API asgpt-6.2-astraandgpt-6.2-sol. I shippedLLM 0.38with support for the new models.

6.2 Astra is 80% of the price of 6 Astra - $8/MTok input and $40/MTok output, the same price as Claude Fable 5.2 (which was also 80% of its predecessor). 6 Astra and Fable 5 were both $10/$50. The cached price is an even bigger discount - $0.40/million compared to $1/million for the older model. This is great news for longer running agentic sessions.

GPT-6.2 Sol is the same $2/$10 price as 6.1 Sol and 6 Sol - which are half the price of GPT-5.6 Sol ($4/$20).

Here are the pelicansfor GPT-6.2 Solandfor GPT-6.2 Astra. The 6.2 Astra max pelican looks like this:

I have afull comparison grid here, but here's how the high/xhigh/max pelicans compare with the previous Sol and Astra releases:

I also ran my most recent benchmark prompt against the two models, using "Ultra' effort levels in the Codex CLI:

Make a three js animation where yonkers stands up as a big mech (cool stand up motion) and stomps around manhattan and queens and Brooklyn, use openstreetmap mapping data

Here'sSoland here'sAstra. Neither of them did a good enough job of morphing Yonkers into a big mech, at least in comparison toClaude Fable 5.2andGemini 4 Carbon.

This video showing the Astra and Sol animations playing out at the same time:

I created that video using GPT-6.2 Astra (Ultra) in the Codex desktop app by prompting:

https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/yonkers-gpt-6.2-astra-ultra/index.html and https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2026/yonkers-gpt-6.2-sol-ultra/index.html are two videos of the same thing by two different models

I need a video of the first 10 seconds where the top half of the video plays the first and the bottom half plays the second

I need an overlaid label of "GPT-6.2 Astra" on the top half and "GPT-6.2 Sol" on the bottom half. These labels should be tastefully positioned.

Make the video square and 2000x2000 pixels

Then later:

OK make it 20s

Here's theexported transcript.

The buzz around these new models is mixed at the moment. Astra 6.2 isn't scoring quite as high as Fable 5.2 on various benchmarks, and I've seen a few complaints that its communication style can be confusing. Theo Browne'sreview(in the form of a feedback letter he sent OpenAI during pre-release) has this useful example:

When this model is working on long tasks, it can pull in a lot of subagents and manage them pretty well. It will then proceed to randomlyask you some weird internal implementation detail bullshit that you could not under any earthly circumstance understand, much less have input on.

I sent "/goal make a new level for Outer Wilds". 2 hours in, it's "blocked" because it wanted to ask me "does r24's reviewer write it's clips to 24_g521.mp4 or 24_p11.mp4?"

<!DOCTYPE html>
< img id="wx_img" src="https://www.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/imgs/qbitai-logo-1.png" width="400" height="400">

GPT-6.2 Astra和Sol王炸双发！3D又危了

梦瑶2026-11-1808:49:14来源：量子位

Sol逼近旗舰性能

梦瑶 发自 凹非寺

量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI

OpenAI，你是真会玩王炸双发啊。

GPT-6.2 Astra和GPT-6.2 Sol，这次一起等来了！！！（欢呼.jpg）

不得不说，Astra各方面性能，这回一起卷起来了——

  • 复杂Agent能力升级：Astra专业任务评测比前代提升5.2个百分点，任务成本降至三分之一以下。
  • 科研能力刷新纪录：相关评测提升9个百分点，OpenAI直接称其为全球最强科学家模型。
  • 编程能力再升级：在FrontierCode 2.0评测中拿下44.2%，较前代提升1.4个百分点。
  • 3D生成登顶榜单：在Artificial Analysis的AA-3D评测中以1318 Elo拿下第一，超过Fable 5.2的1271分。

模型到底多能打，我们直接上才艺展示~

来看这个， Astra化身网页设计师，从布局到配图一手包办，还能为不同网站量身打造专属视觉风格：

再看这个，仅凭照片和手册，Astra就把遥控汽车连发动机都建模了，组装动画也一并搞定，有点厉害哈：

在AA-3D评测中，更是以1318 Elo登顶榜单，精细的3D模型说搓就搓，沉浸式交互场景也能直接生成，be like：

△x@fal

轻量版Sol同样亮眼，编程能力逼近Astra，任务成本仅为其五分之一。

价格上，6.2 Astra的API价格直降20%——

输入每百万Token8美元、输出40美元，缓存输入价格更是下降60%。

6.2 Sol维持原价，API输入、输出每百万Token分别为2美元和10美元。

目前，两款模型已经登陆ChatGPT Work、Codex和API，Plus、Pro等订阅用户均可使用。

精话不多说，新模型具体能力我们直接来看～

Astra刷新专业任务纪录，Sol逼近旗舰性能

先来看这次GPT-6.2究竟升级了多少。

OpenAI在官方公告中，把6.2 Astra定位为面向高难度项目的旗舰模型。

6.2 Sol则负责高频、日常的专业任务。

我也帮大家浅浅总结了一波两个模型的能力亮点，我们先来一睹为快！！！

△AI生成

从公布的成绩来看，Astra最明显的进步集中在复杂任务执行、科研、编程和视觉设计上——

复杂专业任务刷新纪录，完成成本降至前代的三分之一以下。

在Agents’ Last Exam评测中，GPT-6.2 Astra比GPT-6 Astra提高5.2个百分点。

与Claude Fable 5.2相比，也领先5.5个百分点，而单任务成本仅为后者的5%，确实有点东西啊。。。

科研能力也继续提升，OpenAI甚至直接给出了「全球最强科学家模型」的定位。

在Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1中，Astra比前代提升9个百分点，任务成本同样降至三分之一以下。

Vals Science Index也刷新了成绩，其要求模型理解真实生物数据设计实验，并通过实验推断模拟系统的运行规律。

换句话说，相比单纯回答科学知识，已经更接近科研人员实际工作的过程～

当然，编程、3D设计和电脑操作能力，也集体next level了——

在第三方评测机构Artificial Analysis的综合智能指数中，Astra拿下62分，较前代提升5分。

Sol以57分追平上一代旗舰，成本却更低。

3D生成更是亮眼，Astra以1318 Elo登顶AA-3D榜单，超过Claude Fable 5.2的1271分，Sol也拿下1259分。

OpenAI还展示了一个蛮有意思的Demo——

GPT-6.2 Astra直接在CAD软件里上手搞机械设计了。

它能逐个处理机械零件，检查各个组件之间的连接关系，连这种需要精细操作的工程任务也能自己动手完成：

咱再来看下面这个demo。

6.2 Astra直接模拟了一辆汽车在山路上的行驶动态。

items.title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
items.summary: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. content.html: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.

items.title: Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache
items.summary: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. content.html: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values. A naive per-token quantizer makes keys appear much more sensitive: splitting a 12-bit budget, K8V4 beats K4V8 in acceptance by 10.87pp. However, with grouped per-channel keys, the gap becomes -0.25pp. A controlled Qwen test confirms that changing only the key quantizer can erase or reverse the preferred bit split. Hence, following KIVI, we propose K4V4 quantization with per-channel keys and per-token values. Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.14%, only 1.36% relative. Overall, quantized draft caches can make speculative decoding more memory efficient; as a predictive principle for efficient AI design, key and value precision must be co-designed with the quantizer layout.

Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.14%, only 1.36% relative. Overall, quantized draft caches can make speculative decoding more memory efficient; as a predictive principle for efficient AI design, key and value precision must be co-designed with the quantizer layout.
content.lead: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule.
